translated_title: Sheinbaum Highlights PAN's Distancing From Fox Over Remarks on the 2006 Fraud; How Interesting, Now They Don't Want Him to Talk
original_title: Sheinbaum resalta deslinde del PAN de Fox por dichos sobre el fraude en 2006; qué interesante, ahora ya no quieren que hable
author: Alma E. Muñoz and Arturo Sánchez
meta_description: PAN leader Jorge Romero disowned Fox after he admitted his role in 2006, though the party had just brought him back to help in the next election.
